scope: Round 1 only; do not assume round-2 regime or target inventory.
source: User-supplied processed leaderboard chart summary; raw curves/private log not supplied in this workspace.
user_observations: Near-linear PnL across teams; approximately equal quarter contributions.
No large drawdowns visible at 25-second sampling.
Team increment correlations reported at 0.35–0.65; correlations with price changes near zero.
interpretation: Consistent with sustained high-turnover profit; increases the plausibility of execution/fill-quality explanations for round 1.
Sampled curves cannot rule out sub-25-second drawdowns or frequent directional trading.
SD(PnL)/SD(price) is not an inventory estimator without assumptions about turnover, covariance, other PnL components and the definition of the price-change scale.
Even that conditional ratio is about 92 lots for second place, not 60–80 lots for every leader.
Round-2 family selection must start from new public-tape evidence; preserve maker and trend/taker alternatives.
